premises.text: Africa faces a developer shortage and children need to become creators of technology, not only consumers
premises.evidence_span: Africa suffers from what I would love to call SOD, shortage of developers

premises.text: A gamified block-based programming app with AR lessons teaches kids coding fundamentals offline
premises.evidence_span: learn the fundamentals of computer programming through game puzzles

premises.text: Offline-first design expands reach where internet penetration is low while staying locally relevant
premises.evidence_span: our application works fully offline, ensuring inclusivity in regions where internet penetration is very low

premises.text: Revenue comes from an in-app character store and branded-character partnerships

value.text: Children learn programming in an easy, fun way and become tech creators
value.evidence_span: Programming has never been this easy and fun
